stories.title: Chinese American Fields Medalist Calls for Math Collaboration in AI Age
stories.simple_summary: A mathematician from China and America is encouraging people to work together on math skills needed for artificial intelligence. This is about making sure different countries cooperate on AI knowledge.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to researchers and universities. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: AI labs sitting on ‘bombshell’ revelations that could cause global chaos, experts warn
stories.simple_summary: Some AI experts say that AI companies have discovered important information they haven't told the public about yet, and they worry it could cause serious problems. The experts think people should know about these findings.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a warning about keeping watch on what AI companies are doing, though the details aren't clear from the headline alone.

stories.title: Exploring an AI reboot and the ethics that surround it
stories.simple_summary: Someone is looking at what happens when you restart or rebuild an AI system, and asking what the right and wrong ways to do it are. This is about being fair and honest when making changes to AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to people building AI systems. Regular people won't see this directly.

stories.title: Trump’s AI Gambit Fuels Wild Thanksgiving Week on Wall Street
stories.simple_summary: President Trump has made decisions about artificial intelligence that caused big ups and downs in stock prices on Wall Street during Thanksgiving week. Investors were reacting strongly to his choices.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people with stock portfolios. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Russia’s Big Ambitions for A.I. Are Undercut by Constraints of War
stories.simple_summary: Russia wants to become a leader in artificial intelligence, but their involvement in war is making that goal harder for them. The conflict is taking resources and attention away from AI work.
stories.why_it_matters: This is news about other countries' technology plans. It doesn't affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: A gadget straight out of a James Bond film: Tiny tooth-mounted sensor recognizes silent speech
stories.simple_summary: Scientists have made a tiny sensor so small it can fit on a tooth, and it can understand what you're thinking or saying even when you're not making noise out loud. It works like those spy gadgets in movies.
stories.why_it_matters: This is still experimental technology. It may never become something regular people use.

stories.title: Android’s DIY widgets are a bit of vibe-coding fun
stories.simple_summary: Android phones can now have small AI helpers that show you useful information without you having to open an app. For example, one could tell you if you're about to miss your bus without you tapping around.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use an Android phone, this means AI tools could make finding information faster and easier in the future.

stories.title: Why SAP’s second 10,000-job overhaul in two years matters to CIOs
stories.simple_summary: A big software company called SAP is laying off 10,000 workers for the second time in two years, and this matters to business technology leaders. It's a big change in how the company is organized.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to companies using SAP's software and IT managers. Small businesses should ignore this.

stories.title: Los Angeles schools block Google’s AI features, consider dropping tech giant’s products
stories.simple_summary: Los Angeles schools have turned off artificial intelligence features from Google and might stop using Google products altogether. They're concerned about how AI is being used with student information.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have kids or grandkids in Los Angeles schools, the district is being cautious about protecting their privacy with AI tools.

stories.title: Not Nvidia. Not Micron. If I Could Buy and Hold Only 1 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Semiconductor Stock Through 2030, This Would Be It.
stories.simple_summary: An investor is recommending one particular AI chip company over famous ones like Nvidia or Micron. This is advice about which stock to buy if you're investing for the next six years.
stories.why_it_matters: This is for investors only. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia, a big chip maker, has stopped sending computer chips to countries in Southeast Asia because the United States is trying to prevent those powerful chips from reaching China. This is a trade restriction.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly affects tech companies and world trade. It won't change what you can buy in stores.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
stories.simple_summary: A new Grand Theft Auto video game became hugely popular by using real humans to create it instead of relying completely on AI to make the game. The game was made the hard way, with lots of careful work by people.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that human creativity still matters and can create something better than rushing AI to do everything fast.
